inherits: live-plan-b3-v1 environment scores, Plan B gates, and consistency-v2 candidate ordering
environment_selection: Take the strongest Tier A/B environment from every active league first, then fill the remaining environment slots up to five by score.
candidate_selection: Rank home-only Plan B candidates using consistency v2, retain only the best candidate from each league, then keep at most three.

within_similar_group_order: minimum shots across previous five starts descending
population standard deviation of shots across previous five starts ascending
average player share of team shots descending

integrity: Never force a candidate from a league when nobody passes every Plan B requirement.
Every candidate must represent the home team and later be confirmed in the home starting XI.
Never promote a lower-ranked replacement after the board is frozen.
